text: And in the lists were all their little ones and their wives and their sons and daughters, through all the people: they made themselves holy in the positions which they were given.

title: II Chronicles 31:19
text: And as for the sons of Aaron, the priests, living in the country on the outskirts of their towns, every different town there were men, marked out by name, to give their part of the goods to all the males among the priests, and to all who were listed among the Levites.

title: II Chronicles 31:20
text: This Hezekiah did through all Judah; he did what was good and right and true before the Lord his God.

title: II Chronicles 31:21
text: And for everything he undertook, in connection with the work of the house of God and his law and orders, he got directions from God and did it with serious purpose; and things went well for him.

title: II Chronicles 32:1
text: ¶Now after these things and this true-hearted work, Sennacherib, king of Assyria, came into Judah, and put his army in position before the walled towns of Judah, designing to make his way into them by force.

title: II Chronicles 32:2
text: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib had come for the purpose of fighting against Jerusalem,

title: II Chronicles 32:3
text: He took up with his rulers and men of war the question of stopping up the water-springs outside the town; and they gave him their support.

title: II Chronicles 32:4
text: So they got together a great number of people, and had all the water-springs and the stream flowing through the land stopped up, saying, Why let the kings of Assyria come and have much water?

title: II Chronicles 32:5
text: Then he took heart, building up the wall where it was broken down, and making its towers higher, and building another wall outside; and he made strong the Millo in the town of David, and got together a great store of all sorts of instruments of war.

title: II Chronicles 32:6
text: And he put war chiefs over the people, and sent for them all to come together to him in the wide place at the doorway into the town, and to give them heart he said to them,

title: II Chronicles 32:7
text: Be strong and take heart; have no fear, and do not be troubled on account of the king of Assyria and all the great army with him: for there is a greater with us.

title: II Chronicles 32:8
text: With him is an arm of flesh; but we have the Lord our God, helping us and fighting for us. And the people put their faith in what Hezekiah, king of Judah, said.

title: II Chronicles 32:9
text: ¶After this, Sennacherib, king of Assyria, sent his servants to Jerusalem (at that time he was stationed with all his army in front of Lachish), to say to Hezekiah and all the men of Judah in Jerusalem,

title: II Chronicles 32:10
text: Sennacherib, king of Assyria, says, In what are you placing your hope, waiting here in the walled town of Jerusalem?

title: II Chronicles 32:11
text: Is it not Hezekiah who has got you to do it, causing your death from need of food and water, by saying, The Lord our God will give us salvation out of the hands of the king of Assyria?

title: II Chronicles 32:12
text: Has not this same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, saying to Judah and Jerusalem, Give worship before one altar only, burning offerings on it?

title: II Chronicles 32:13
text: Have you no knowledge of what I and my fathers have done to all the peoples of every land? were the gods of the nations of those lands able to keep their land from falling into my hands?

title: II Chronicles 32:14
text: Who was there among all the gods of those nations, which my fathers put to destruction, who was able to keep his people safe from my hands? and is it possible that your God will keep you safe from my hands?

title: II Chronicles 32:15
text: So do not be tricked by Hezekiah or let him get you to do this, and do not put any faith in what he says: for no god of any nation or kingdom has been able to keep his people safe from my hands, or the hands of my fathers: how much less will your God keep you safe from my hands!

title: II Chronicles 32:16
text: And his servants said even more against the Lord God and against his servant Hezekiah.

title: II Chronicles 32:17
text: And he sent letters, in addition, to put shame on the Lord, the God of Israel, and to say evil against him, saying, As the gods of the nations of other lands have not been able to keep their people safe from my hands, no more will the God of Hezekiah keep his people safe from my hands.

title: II Chronicles 32:18
text: These things they said, crying out with a loud voice in the Jews' language, to the people of Jerusalem who were on the wall, with the purpose of troubling them and putting fear into them, so that they might take the town;

title: II Chronicles 32:19
text: Talking of the God of Jerusalem as if he was like the gods of the peoples of the earth, the work of men's hands.

title: II Chronicles 32:20
text: And Hezekiah the king, and Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, made prayer because of this, crying out to heaven.

title: II Chronicles 32:21
text: And the Lord sent an angel who put to death all the men of war and the chiefs and the captains in the army of the king of Assyria. So he went back to his country in shame. And when he came into the house of his god, his sons, the offspring of his body, put him to death there with the sword.

title: II Chronicles 32:22
text: So the Lord gave Hezekiah and the people of Jerusalem salvation from the power of Sennacherib, the king of Assyria, and from all others, giving them rest on every side.

title: II Chronicles 32:23
text: And great numbers came to Jerusalem with offerings for the Lord, and things of great price for Hezekiah, king of Judah: so that he was honoured among all nations from that time.

title: II Chronicles 32:24
text: ¶In those days Hezekiah was ill and near death; and he made prayer to the Lord, and the Lord in answer gave him a sign.

title: II Chronicles 32:25
text: But Hezekiah did not do as had been done to him; for his heart was lifted up in pride; and so wrath came on him and on Judah and Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 32:26
text: But then, Hezekiah, in sorrow for what he had done, put away his pride; and he and all Jerusalem made themselves low, so that the wrath of the Lord did not come on them in Hezekiah's life-time.

title: II Chronicles 32:27
text: And Hezekiah had very great wealth and honour; and he made himself store-houses for his gold and silver and jewels and spices, and for body-covers and all sorts of beautiful vessels.

title: II Chronicles 32:28
text: And store-houses for the produce of grain and wine and oil; and buildings for all sorts of beasts and flocks.

title: II Chronicles 32:29
text: And he made towns for himself, and got together much property in flocks and herds: for God had given him great wealth.

title: II Chronicles 32:30
text: It was Hezekiah who had the higher spring of the water of Gihon stopped, and the water taken down on the west side of the town of David. In everything he undertook, Hezekiah did well.

title: II Chronicles 32:31
text: However, in the business of the representatives sent by the rulers of Babylon to get news of the wonder which had taken place in the land, God gave up guiding him, testing him to see what was in his heart.

title: II Chronicles 32:32
text: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and the good he did, are recorded in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, and in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

title: II Chronicles 32:33
text: So Hezekiah went to rest with his fathers, and they put his body into the higher part of the resting-places of the sons of David: and all Judah and the people of Jerusalem gave him honour at his death. And Manasseh his son became king in his place.

title: II Chronicles 33:1
text: ¶Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he was ruling for fifty-five years in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 33:2
text: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, copying the disgusting ways of the nations whom the Lord had sent out of the land before the children of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 33:3
text: For he put up again the high places which had been pulled down by his father Hezekiah; and he made altars for the Baals, and pillars of wood, and was a worshipper and servant of all the stars of heaven;

title: II Chronicles 33:4
text: And he made altars in the house of the Lord, of which the Lord had said, In Jerusalem will my name be for ever.

title: II Chronicles 33:5
text: And he made altars for all the stars of heaven in the two outer squares of the house of the Lord.

title: II Chronicles 33:6
text: More than this, he made his children go through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom; and he made use of secret arts, and signs for reading the future, and unnatural powers, and gave positions to those who had control of spirits and to wonder-workers: he did much evil in the eyes of the Lord, moving him to wrath.

title: II Chronicles 33:7
text: And he put the image he had made in the house of God, the house of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, the town which I have made mine out of all the tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:

title: II Chronicles 33:8
text: And never again will I let the feet of Israel be moved out of the land which I have given to their fathers; if only they will take care to do all my orders, even all the law and the orders and the rules given to them by Moses.

title: II Chronicles 33:9
text: And Manasseh made Judah and the people of Jerusalem go out of the true way, so that they did more evil than those nations whom the Lord gave up to destruction before the children of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 33:10
text: And the word of the Lord came to Manasseh and his people, but they gave no attention.

title: II Chronicles 33:11
text: ¶So the Lord sent against them the captains of the army of Assyria, who made Manasseh a prisoner and took him away in chains to Babylon.

title: II Chronicles 33:12
text: And crying out to the Lord his God in his trouble, he made himself low before the God of his fathers,

title: II Chronicles 33:13
text: And made prayer to him; and in answer to his prayer God let him come back to Jerusalem and to his kingdom. Then Manasseh was certain that the Lord was God.

title: II Chronicles 33:14
text: After this he made an outer wall for the town of David, on the west side of Gihon in the valley, as far as the way into the town by the fish doorway; and he put a very high wall round the Ophel; and he put captains of the army in all the walled towns of Judah.

title: II Chronicles 33:15
text: He took away the strange gods and the image out of the house of the Lord, and all the altars he had put up on the hill of the Lord's house and in Jerusalem, and put them out of the town.

title: II Chronicles 33:16
text: And he put the altar of the Lord in order, offering peace-offerings and praise-offerings on it, and said that all Judah were to be servants of the Lord, the God of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 33:17
text: However, the people still made offerings in the high places, but only to the Lord their God.

title: II Chronicles 33:18
text: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer to his God, and the words which the seers said to him in the name of the Lord, the God of Israel, are recorded among the acts of the kings of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 33:19
text: And the prayer which he made to God, and how God gave him an answer, and all his sin and his wrongdoing, and the places where he made high places and put up pillars of wood and images, before he put away his pride, are recorded in the history of the seers.

title: II Chronicles 33:20
text: So Manasseh went to rest with his fathers, and they put his body to rest in his house, and Amon his son became king in his place.

title: II Chronicles 33:21
text: ¶Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king; and he was ruling for two years in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 33:22
text: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, as Manasseh his father had done; and Amon made offerings to all the images which his father Manasseh had made, and was their servant.

title: II Chronicles 33:23
text: He did not make himself low before the Lord, as his father Manasseh had done, but went on sinning more and more.

title: II Chronicles 33:24
text: And his servants made a secret design against him, and put him to death in his house.

title: II Chronicles 33:25
text: But the people of the land put to death all those who had taken part in the design against King Amon, and made his son Josiah king in his place.

title: II Chronicles 34:1
text: ¶Josiah was eight years old when he became king; he was ruling in Jerusalem for thirty-one years.

title: II Chronicles 34:2
text: And he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord, walking in the ways of his father David, without turning to the right hand or to the left.

title: II Chronicles 34:3
text: In the eighth year of his rule, while he was still young, his heart was first turned to the God of his father David; and in the twelfth year he undertook the clearing away of all the high places and the pillars and the images of wood and metal from Judah and Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 34:4
text: He had the altars of the Baals broken down, while he himself was present; and the sun-images which were placed on high over them he had cut down; and the pillars of wood and the metal images he had broken up and crushed to dust, dropping the dust over the resting-places of the dead who had made offerings to them.

title: II Chronicles 34:5
text: And he had the bones of the priests burned on their altars, and so he made Judah and Jerusalem clean.

title: II Chronicles 34:6
text: And in all the towns of Manasseh and Ephraim and Simeon as far as Naphtali, he made waste their houses round about.

title: II Chronicles 34:7
text: He had the altars and the pillars of wood pulled down and the images crushed to dust, and all the sun-images cut down, through all the land of Israel, and then he went back to Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 34:8
text: ¶Now in the eighteenth year of his rule, when the land and the house had been made clean, he sent Shaphan, the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah, the ruler of the town, and Joah, the son of Joahaz, the recorder, to make good what was damaged in the house of the Lord his God.

title: II Chronicles 34:9
text: And they came to Hilkiah, the chief priest, and gave him all the money which had been taken into the house of God, which the Levites, the keepers of the door, had got from Manasseh and Ephraim and those of Israel who had not been taken away as prisoners, and from all Judah and Benjamin and the people of Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 34:10
text: And they gave it to the overseers of the work of the Lord's house, and the overseers gave it to the workmen working in the house, for building it up and making good what was damaged;

title: II Chronicles 34:11
text: Even to the woodworkers and builders to get cut stone and wood for joining the structure together and for making boards for the houses which the kings of Judah had given up to destruction.

title: II Chronicles 34:12
text: And the men did the work well; and those who had authority over them were Jahath and Obadiah, Levites of the sons of Merari, and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, who were to be responsible for seeing that the work was done; and others of the Levites, who were expert with instruments of music,

title: II Chronicles 34:13
text: Had authority over the transport workers, giving directions to all who were doing any sort of work; and among the Levites there were scribes and overseers and door-keepers.

title: II Chronicles 34:14
text: ¶Now when they were taking out the money which had come into the Lord's house, Hilkiah the priest came across the book of the law of the Lord, which he had given by the mouth of Moses.

title: II Chronicles 34:15
text: Then Hilkiah said to Shaphan the scribe, I have made discovery of the book of the law in the house of the Lord. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan.

title: II Chronicles 34:16
text: And Shaphan took the book to the king; and he gave him an account of what had been done, saying, Your servants are doing all they have been given to do;

title: II Chronicles 34:17
text: They have taken out all the money which was in the Lord's house and have given it to the overseers and to the workmen.

title: II Chronicles 34:18
text: Then Shaphan the scribe said to the king, Hilkiah the priest has given me a book; and he made a start at reading some of it to the king.

title: II Chronicles 34:19
text: And the king, hearing the words of the law, took his robe in his hands, violently parting it as a sign of his grief.

title: II Chronicles 34:20
text: And he gave orders to Hilkiah and to Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, and Abdon, the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe and Asaiah, the king's servant, saying,

title: II Chronicles 34:21
text: Go and get directions from the Lord for me and for those who are still in Israel and for Judah, about the words of this book which has come to light; for great is the wrath of the Lord which has been let loose on us, because our fathers have not kept the word of the Lord or done what is recorded in this book.

title: II Chronicles 34:22
text: So Hilkiah, and those whom the king sent, went to Huldah the woman prophet, the wife of Shallum, the son of Tokhath, the son of Hasrah, the keeper of the robes (now she was living in Jerusalem, in the second part of the town); and they had talk with her about this thing.

title: II Chronicles 34:23
text: And she said to them, The Lord, the God of Israel, has said, Say to the man who sent you to me,

title: II Chronicles 34:24
text: These are the words of the Lord: See, I will send evil on this place and on its people, even all the curses in the book which they have been reading before the king of Judah;

title: II Chronicles 34:25
text: Because they have given me up, burning offerings to other gods and moving me to wrath by all the works of their hands; so my wrath is let loose on this place and will not be put out.

title: II Chronicles 34:26
text: But to the king of Judah who sent you to get directions from the Lord, say, This is what the Lord, the God of Israel, has said: Because you have given ear to my words,

title: II Chronicles 34:27
text: And your heart was soft, and you made yourself low before God, on hearing his words about this place and its people, and with weeping and signs of grief have made yourself low before me, I have given ear to you, says the Lord God.

title: II Chronicles 34:28
text: See, I will let you go to your fathers, and be put in your last resting-place in peace, and your eyes will not see all the evil which I will send on this place and on its people. So they took this news back to the king.

title: II Chronicles 34:29
text: ¶Then the king sent and got together all the responsible men of Judah and of Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 34:30
text: And the king went up to the house of the Lord, with all the men of Judah and the people of Jerusalem, and the priests and the Levites and all the people, small and great; and they were present at his reading of the book of the law which had come to light in the house of the Lord.

title: II Chronicles 34:31
text: Then the king, taking his place by the pillar, made an agreement before the Lord, to go in the way of the Lord, and to keep his orders and his decisions and his rules with all his heart and with all his soul, and to keep the words of the agreement recorded in this book.

title: II Chronicles 34:32
text: And he made all the people in Jerusalem and Benjamin give their word to keep it. And the people of Jerusalem kept the agreement of God, the God of their fathers.

title: II Chronicles 34:33
text: Josiah took away all the disgusting things out of all the lands of the children of Israel, and made all who were in Israel servants of the Lord their God. And as long as he was living they were true to the Lord, the God of their fathers.

title: II Chronicles 35:1
text: ¶And Josiah kept a Passover to the Lord in Jerusalem; on the fourteenth day of the first month they put the Passover lamb to death.

title: II Chronicles 35:2
text: And he gave the priests their places, making them strong for the work of the house of God.

title: II Chronicles 35:3
text: And he said to the Levites, the teachers of all Israel, who were holy to the Lord, See, the holy ark is in the house which Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel, made; it will no longer have to be transported on your backs: now be the servants of the Lord your God and his people Israel,

title: II Chronicles 35:4
text: And make yourselves ready in your divisions, by your families, as it is ordered in the writings of David, king of Israel, and of Solomon his son;

title: II Chronicles 35:5
text: And take your positions in the holy place, grouped in the families of your brothers, the children of the people, and for every division let there be a part of a family of the Levites.

title: II Chronicles 35:6
text: And put the Passover lamb to death, and make yourselves holy, and make it ready for your brothers, so that the orders given by the Lord through Moses may be done.

title: II Chronicles 35:7
text: And Josiah gave lambs and goats from the flock as Passover offerings for all the people who were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand oxen: these were from the king's private property.

title: II Chronicles 35:8
text: And his captains freely gave an offering to the people, the priests, and the Levites. Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, the rulers of the house of God, gave to the priests for the Passover offerings two thousand, six hundred small cattle and three hundred oxen.

title: II Chronicles 35:9
text: And Conaniah and Shemaiah and Nethanel, his brothers, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, the chiefs of the Levites, gave to the Levites for the Passover offerings five thousand small cattle and five hundred oxen.

title: II Chronicles 35:10
text: So everything was made ready and the priests took their places with the Levites in their divisions, as the king had said.

title: II Chronicles 35:11
text: And they put the Passover lambs to death, the blood being drained out by the priests when it was given to them, and the Levites did the skinning.

title: II Chronicles 35:12
text: And they took away the burned offerings, so that they might give them to be offered to the Lord for the divisions of the families of the people, as it is recorded in the book of Moses. And they did the same with the oxen.

title: II Chronicles 35:13
text: And the Passover lamb was cooked over the fire, as it says in the law; and the holy offerings were cooked in pots and basins and vessels, and taken quickly to all the people.

title: II Chronicles 35:14
text: And after that, they made ready for themselves and for the priests; for the priests, the sons of Aaron, were offering the burned offerings and the fat till night; so the Levites made ready what was needed for themselves and for the priests, the sons of Aaron.

title: II Chronicles 35:15
text: And the sons of Asaph, the makers of melody, were in their places, as ordered by David and Asaph and Heman and Jeduthun, the king's seer; and the door-keepers were stationed at every door: there was no need for them to go away from their places, for their brothers the Levites made ready for them.

title: II Chronicles 35:16
text: So everything needed for the worship of the Lord was made ready that same day, for the keeping of the Passover and the offering of burned offerings on the altar of the Lord, as King Josiah had given orders.

title: II Chronicles 35:17
text: And all the children of Israel who were present kept the Passover and the feast of unleavened bread at that time for seven days.

title: II Chronicles 35:18
text: No Passover like it had been kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet; and not one of the kings of Israel had ever kept a Passover like the one kept by Josiah and the priests and the Levites and all those of Judah and Israel who were present, and the people of Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 35:19
text: In the eighteenth year of the rule of Josiah this Passover was kept.

title: II Chronicles 35:20
text: ¶After all this, and after Josiah had put the house in order, Neco, king of Egypt, went up to make war at Carchemish by the river Euphrates; and Josiah went out against him.

title: II Chronicles 35:21
text: But he sent representatives to him, saying, What have I to do with you, O king of Judah? I have not come against you this day, but against those with whom I am at war; and God has given me orders to go forward quickly: keep out of God's way, for he is with me, or he will send destruction on you.

title: II Chronicles 35:22
text: However, Josiah would not go back; but keeping to his purpose of fighting against him, and giving no attention to the words of Neco, which came from God, he went forward to the fight in the valley of Megiddo.

title: II Chronicles 35:23
text: And the bowmen sent their arrows at King Josiah, and the king said to his servants, Take me away, for I am badly wounded.

title: II Chronicles 35:24
text: So his servants took him out of the line of war-carriages, and put him in his second carriage and took him to Jerusalem, where he came to his end, and they put his body in the resting-place of his fathers. And in all Judah and Jerusalem there was great weeping for Josiah.

title: II Chronicles 35:25
text: And Jeremiah made a song of grief for Josiah; and to this day Josiah is named by all the makers of melody, men and women, in their songs of grief; they made it a rule in Israel; and the songs are recorded among the songs of grief.

title: II Chronicles 35:26
text: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and the good he did, in keeping with what is recorded in the law of the Lord,

title: II Chronicles 35:27
text: And all his acts, first and last, are recorded in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

title: II Chronicles 36:1
text: ¶Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz, the son of Josiah, and made him king in Jerusalem in place of his father.

title: II Chronicles 36:2
text: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king; he was ruling in Jerusalem for three months.

title: II Chronicles 36:3
text: Then the king of Egypt took the kingdom from him in Jerusalem, and put on the land a tax of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

title: II Chronicles 36:4
text: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, changing his name to Jehoiakim. And Neco took his brother Jehoahaz away to Egypt.

title: II Chronicles 36:5
text: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king; he was ruling in Jerusalem for eleven years, and he did evil in the eyes of the Lord his God.

title: II Chronicles 36:6
text: Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, came up against him, and took him away in chains to Babylon.

title: II Chronicles 36:7
text: And Nebuchadnezzar took away some of the vessels of the Lord's house, and put them in the house of his god in Babylon.

title: II Chronicles 36:8
text: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim and the disgusting things he did, and all there is to be said against him, are recorded in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah; and Jehoiachin his son became king in his place.

title: II Chronicles 36:9
text: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king; he was ruling in Jerusalem for three months and ten days, and he did evil in the eyes of the Lord.

title: II Chronicles 36:10
text: In the spring of the year King Nebuchadnezzar sent and took him away to Babylon, with the beautiful vessels of the house of the Lord, and made Zedekiah, his father's brother, king over Judah and Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 36:11
text: ¶Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king; he was ruling in Jerusalem for eleven years.

title: II Chronicles 36:12
text: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, and did not make himself low before Jeremiah the prophet who gave him the word of the Lord.

title: II Chronicles 36:13
text: And he took up arms against King Nebuchadnezzar, though he had made him take an oath by God; but he made his neck stiff and his heart hard, turning away from the Lord, the God of Israel.

title: II Chronicles 36:14
text: And more than this, all the great men of Judah and the priests and the people made their sin great, turning to all the disgusting ways of the nations; and they made unclean the house of the Lord which he had made holy in Jerusalem.

title: II Chronicles 36:15
text: And the Lord, the God of their fathers, sent word to them by his servants, sending early and frequently, because he had pity on his people and on his living-place;

title: II Chronicles 36:16
text: But they put shame on the servants of God, making sport of his words and laughing at his prophets, till the wrath of God was moved against his people, till there was no help.

title: II Chronicles 36:17
text: So he sent against them the king of the Chaldaeans, who put their young men to death with the sword in the house of their holy place, and had no pity for any, young man or virgin, old man or white-haired: God gave them all into his hands.

title: II Chronicles 36:18
text: And all the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the stored wealth of the Lord's house and the wealth of the king and his chiefs, he took away to Babylon.

title: II Chronicles 36:19
text: And the house of God was burned and the wall of Jerusalem broken down; all its great houses were burned with fire and all its beautiful vessels given up to destruction.

title: II Chronicles 36:20
text: And all who had not come to death by the sword he took away prisoners to Babylon; and they became servants to him and to his sons till the kingdom of Persia came to power:

title: II Chronicles 36:21
text: So that the words of the Lord, which he said by the mouth of Jeremiah, might come true, till the land had had pleasure in her Sabbaths; for as long as she was waste the land kept the Sabbath, till seventy years were complete.

title: II Chronicles 36:22
text: ¶Now in the first year of Cyrus, king of Persia, in order that the words which the Lord had said by the mouth of Jeremiah might come true, the spirit of Cyrus, king of Persia, was moved by the Lord, and he made a public statement and had it given out through all his kingdom and put in writing, saying,

title: II Chronicles 36:23
text: Cyrus, king of Persia, has said, All the kingdoms of the earth have been given to me by the Lord, the God of heaven; and he has made me responsible for building a house for him in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Whoever there is among you of all his people, may the Lord his God be with him and let him go up.

title: Ezra 1:1
text: ¶Now in the first year of Cyrus, king of Persia, in order that the word of the Lord given by the mouth of Jeremiah might come true, the spirit of Cyrus, king of Persia, was moved by the Lord, so that he made a public statement through all his kingdom, and put it in writing, saying,

title: Ezra 1:2
text: These are the words of Cyrus, king of Persia: The Lord God of heaven has given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he has made me responsible for building a house for him in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

title: Ezra 1:3
text: Whoever there is among you of his people, may his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and take in hand the building of the house of the Lord, the God of Israel; he is the God who is in Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 1:4
text: And whoever there may be of the rest of Israel, living in any place, let the men of that place give him help with offerings of silver and gold and goods and beasts, in addition to the offering freely given for the house of God in Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 1:5
text: ¶Then the heads of families of Judah and Benjamin, with the priests and the Levites, got ready, even all those whose spirits were moved by God to go up and take in hand the building of the Lord's house in Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 1:6
text: And all their neighbours gave them help with offerings of vessels of silver and gold and goods and beasts and things of great value, in addition to what was freely offered.

title: Ezra 1:7
text: And Cyrus the king got out the vessels of the house of the Lord which Nebuchadnezzar had taken from Jerusalem and put in the house of his gods;

title: Ezra 1:8
text: Even these Cyrus made Mithredath, the keeper of his wealth, get out, and he gave them, after numbering them, to Sheshbazzar, the ruler of Judah.

title: Ezra 1:9
text: And this is the number of them: there were thirty gold plates, a thousand silver plates, twenty-nine knives,

title: Ezra 1:10
text: Thirty gold basins, four hundred and ten silver basins, and a thousand other vessels.

title: Ezra 1:11
text: There were five thousand, four hundred gold and silver vessels. All these were taken back by Sheshbazzar, when those who had been taken prisoner went up from Babylon to Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 2:1
text: ¶Now these are the people of the divisions of the kingdom, among those who had been made prisoners by Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, and taken away to Babylon, who went back to Jerusalem and Judah, everyone to his town;

title: Ezra 2:2
text: Who went with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah, The number of the men of the people of Israel:

title: Ezra 2:3
text: The children of Parosh, two thousand, one hundred and seventy-two.

title: Ezra 2:4
text: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred and seventy-two.

title: Ezra 2:5
text: The children of Arah, seven hundred and seventy-five.

title: Ezra 2:6
text: The children of Pahath-moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand, eight hundred and twelve.

title: Ezra 2:7
text: The children of Elam, a thousand, two hundred and fifty-four.

title: Ezra 2:8
text: The children of Zattu, nine hundred and forty-five.

title: Ezra 2:9
text: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and sixty.

title: Ezra 2:10
text: The children of Bani, six hundred and forty-two.

title: Ezra 2:11
text: The children of Bebai, six hundred and twenty-three.

title: Ezra 2:12
text: The children of Azgad, a thousand, two hundred and twenty-two.

title: Ezra 2:13
text: The children of Adonikam, six hundred and sixty-six.

title: Ezra 2:14
text: The children of Bigvai, two thousand and fifty-six.

title: Ezra 2:15
text: The children of Adin, four hundred and fifty-four.

title: Ezra 2:16
text: The children of Ater, of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.

title: Ezra 2:17
text: The children of Bezai, three hundred and twenty-three.

title: Ezra 2:18
text: The children of Jorah, a hundred and twelve.

title: Ezra 2:19
text: The children of Hashum, two hundred and twenty-three.

title: Ezra 2:20
text: The children of Gibbar, ninety-five.

title: Ezra 2:21
text: The children of Beth-lehem, a hundred and twenty-three.

title: Ezra 2:22
text: The men of Netophah, fifty-six.

title: Ezra 2:23
text: The men of Anathoth, a hundred and twenty-eight.

title: Ezra 2:24
text: The children of Azmaveth, forty-two.

title: Ezra 2:25
text: The children of Kiriath-arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty-three.

title: Ezra 2:26
text: The children of Ramah and Geba, six hundred and twenty-one.

title: Ezra 2:27
text: The men of Michmas, a hundred and twenty-two.

title: Ezra 2:28
text: The men of Beth-el and Ai, two hundred and twenty-three.

title: Ezra 2:29
text: The children of Nebo, fifty-two.

title: Ezra 2:30
text: The children of Magbish, a hundred and fifty-six.

title: Ezra 2:31
text: The children of the other Elam, a thousand, two hundred and fifty-four.

title: Ezra 2:32
text: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

title: Ezra 2:33
text: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred and twenty-five.

title: Ezra 2:34
text: The children of Jericho, three hundred and forty-five.

title: Ezra 2:35
text: The children of Senaah, three thousand, six hundred and thirty.

title: Ezra 2:36
text: ¶The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred and seventy-three.

title: Ezra 2:37
text: The children of Immer, a thousand and fifty-two.

title: Ezra 2:38
text: The children of Pashhur, a thousand, two hundred and forty-seven.

title: Ezra 2:39
text: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.

title: Ezra 2:40
text: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy-four.

title: Ezra 2:41
text: The music-makers: the children of Asaph, a hundred and twenty-eight

title: Ezra 2:42
text: The children of the door-keepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, a hundred and thirty-nine.

title: Ezra 2:43
text: The Nethinim: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

title: Ezra 2:44
text: The children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon,

title: Ezra 2:45
text: The children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,

title: Ezra 2:46
text: The children of Hagab, the children of Shamlai, the children of Hanan,

title: Ezra 2:47
text: The children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah,

title: Ezra 2:48
text: The children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,

title: Ezra 2:49
text: The children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,

title: Ezra 2:50
text: The children of Asnah, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephisim,

title: Ezra 2:51
text: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

title: Ezra 2:52
text: The children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

title: Ezra 2:53
text: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,

title: Ezra 2:54
text: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

title: Ezra 2:55
text: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Hassophereth, the children of Peruda,

title: Ezra 2:56
text: The children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

title: Ezra 2:57
text: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth-hazzebaim, the children of Ami.

title: Ezra 2:58
text: All the Nethinim, and the children of Solomon's servants, were three hundred and ninety-two.

title: Ezra 2:59
text: And these were the people who went up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addan, and Immer. But having no knowledge of their fathers' families or offspring, it was not certain that they were Israelites;

title: Ezra 2:60
text: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred and fifty-two.

title: Ezra 2:61
text: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who was married to one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and took their name.

title: Ezra 2:62
text: They made search for their record among the lists of families, but their names were nowhere to be seen; so they were looked on as unclean and no longer priests.

title: Ezra 2:63
text: And the Tirshatha said that they were not to have the most holy things for their food, till a priest came to give decision by Urim and Thummim.

title: Ezra 2:64
text: ¶The number of all the people together was forty-two thousand, three hundred and sixty,

title: Ezra 2:65
text: As well as their men-servants and their women-servants, of whom there were seven thousand, three hundred and thirty-seven: and they had two hundred men and women to make music.

title: Ezra 2:66
text: They had seven hundred and thirty-six horses, two hundred and forty-five transport beasts,

title: Ezra 2:67
text: Four hundred and thirty-five camels, six thousand, seven hundred and twenty asses.

title: Ezra 2:68
text: And some of the heads of families, when they came to the house of the Lord which is in Jerusalem, gave freely of their wealth for the building up of the house of God in its place:

title: Ezra 2:69
text: Every one, as he was able, gave for the work sixty-one thousand darics of gold, five thousand pounds of silver and a hundred priests' robes.

title: Ezra 2:70
text: So the priests and the Levites and the people and the music-makers and the door-keepers and the Nethinim, took up their places in their towns; even all Israel in their towns.

title: Ezra 3:1
text: ¶And when the seventh month came, and the children of Israel were in the towns, the people came together like one man to Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 3:2
text: Then Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and his brothers the priests, and Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, with his brothers, got up and made the altar of the God of Israel for burned offerings as is recorded in the law of Moses, the man of God.

title: Ezra 3:3
text: They put the altar on its base; for fear was on them because of the people of the countries: and they made burned offerings on it to the Lord, even burned offerings morning and evening.

title: Ezra 3:4
text: And they kept the feast of tents, as it is recorded, making the regular burned offerings every day by number, as it is ordered; for every day what was needed.

title: Ezra 3:5
text: And after that, the regular burned offering and the offerings for the new moons and all the fixed feasts of the Lord which had been made holy, and the offering of everyone who freely gave his offering to the Lord.

title: Ezra 3:6
text: From the first day of the seventh month they made a start with the burned offerings, but the base of the Temple of the Lord had still not been put in its place.

title: Ezra 3:7
text: And they gave money to the stoneworkers and woodworkers; and meat and drink and oil to the people of Zidon and of Tyre, for the transport of cedar-trees from Lebanon to the sea, to Joppa, as Cyrus, king of Persia, had given them authority to do.

title: Ezra 3:8
text: ¶Now in the second year of their coming into the house of God in Jerusalem, in the second month, the work was taken in hand by Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and the rest of their brothers the priests and the Levites, and all those who had come from the land where they were prisoners to Jerusalem: and they made the Levites, of twenty years old and over, responsible for overseeing the work of the house of the Lord.

title: Ezra 3:9
text: Then Jeshua with his sons and his brothers, Kadmiel with his sons, the sons of Hodaviah, together took up the work of overseeing the workmen in the house of God: the sons of Henadad with their sons and their brothers, the Levites.

title: Ezra 3:10
text: And when the builders put in position the base of the Temple of the Lord, the priests, dressed in their robes, took their places with horns, and the Levites, the sons of Asaph, with brass instruments, to give praise to the Lord in the way ordered by David, king of Israel.

title: Ezra 3:11
text: And they gave praise to the Lord, answering one another in their songs and saying, For he is good, for his mercy to Israel is eternal. And all the people gave a great cry of joy, when they gave praise to the Lord, because the base of the Lord's house was put in place.

title: Ezra 3:12
text: But a number of the priests and Levites and the heads of families, old men who had seen the first house, when the base of this house was put down before their eyes, were overcome with weeping; and a number were crying out with joy:

title: Ezra 3:13
text: So that in the ears of the people the cry of joy was mixed with the sound of weeping; for the cries of the people were loud and came to the ears of those who were a long way off.

title: Ezra 4:1
text: ¶Now news came to the haters of Judah and Benjamin that the people who had come back were building a Temple to the Lord, the God of Israel;

title: Ezra 4:2
text: Then they came to Zerubbabel and to the heads of families, and said to them, Let us take part in the building with you; for we are servants of your God, even as you are; and we have been making offerings to him from the days of Esar-haddon, king of Assyria, who put us here.

title: Ezra 4:3
text: But Zerubbabel and Jeshua and the rest of the heads of families in Israel said to them, You have no part with us in the building of a house for our God; we ourselves will do the work together for the Lord, the God of Israel, as Cyrus, king of Persia, has given us orders.

title: Ezra 4:4
text: Then the people of the land made the hands of the people of Judah feeble, troubling them with fear in their building;

title: Ezra 4:5
text: And they gave payment to men who made designs against them and kept them from effecting their purpose, all through the time of Cyrus, king of Persia, till Darius became king.

title: Ezra 4:6
text: ¶And in the time of Ahasuerus, when he first became king, they put on record a statement against the people of Judah and Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 4:7
text: And in the time of Artaxerxes, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of his friends, sent a letter to Artaxerxes, king of Persia, writing it in the Aramaean writing and language.

title: Ezra 4:8
text: Rehum, the chief ruler, and Shimshai the scribe, sent a letter against Jerusalem, to Artaxerxes the king;

title: Ezra 4:9
text: The letter was sent by Rehum, the chief ruler, and Shimshai the scribe and their friends; the Dinaites and the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Shushanchites, the Dehaites, the Elamites,

title: Ezra 4:10
text: And the rest of the nations which the great and noble Osnappar took over and put in Samaria and the rest of the country over the river:

title: Ezra 4:11
text: This is a copy of the letter which they sent to Artaxerxes the king: Your servants living across the river send these words:

title: Ezra 4:12
text: We give news to the king that the Jews who came from you have come to us at Jerusalem; they are building up again that uncontrolled and evil town; the walls are complete and they are joining up the bases.

title: Ezra 4:13
text: The king may be certain that when the building of this town and its walls is complete, they will give no tax or payment in goods or forced payments, and in the end it will be a cause of loss to the kings.

title: Ezra 4:14
text: Now because we are responsible to the king, and it is not right for us to see the king's honour damaged, we have sent to give the king word of these things,

title: Ezra 4:15
text: So that search may be made in the book of the records of your fathers: and you will see in the book of the records that this town has been uncontrolled, and a cause of trouble to kings and countries, and that there were outbursts against authority there in the past: for which reason the town was made waste.

title: Ezra 4:16
text: We give you word, that if the building of this town and its walls is made complete, there will be an end of your power in the country across the river.

title: Ezra 4:17
text: ¶Then the king sent an answer to Rehum, the chief ruler, and Shimshai the scribe, and their friends living in Samaria, and to the rest of those across the river, saying, Peace to you:

title: Ezra 4:18
text: And now the sense of the letter which you sent to us has been made clear to me,

title: Ezra 4:19
text: And I gave orders for a search to be made, and it is certain that in the past this town has made trouble for kings, and that outbursts against authority have taken place there.

title: Ezra 4:20
text: Further, there have been great kings in Jerusalem, ruling over all the country across the river, to whom they gave taxes and payments in goods and forced payments.

title: Ezra 4:21
text: Give an order now, that these men are to do nothing more, and that the building of the town is to be stopped, till I give an order.

title: Ezra 4:22
text: Be certain to do this with all care: do not let trouble be increased to the king's damage.

title: Ezra 4:23
text: Then, after reading the king's letter, Rehum and Shimshai the scribe and their friends went quickly to Jerusalem, to the Jews, and had them stopped by force.

title: Ezra 4:24
text: So the work of the house of God at Jerusalem came to an end; so it was stopped, till the second year of the rule of Darius, king of Persia.

title: Ezra 5:1
text: ¶Now the prophets Haggai and Zechariah, the son of Iddo, were preaching to the Jews in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel.

title: Ezra 5:2
text: Then Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, got up and made a start at building the house of God at Jerusalem: and the prophets of God were with them, helping them.

title: Ezra 5:3
text: ¶At the same time, Tattenai, ruler of the land across the river, and Shethar-bozenai, and their men, came to them and said, Who gave you orders to go on building this house and this wall?

title: Ezra 5:4
text: Then they said these words to them: What are the names of the men who are at work on this building?

title: Ezra 5:5
text: But the eye of their God was on the chiefs of the Jews, and they did not make them give up working till the question had been put before Darius and an answer had come by letter about it.

title: Ezra 5:6
text: This is a copy of the letter which Tattenai, the ruler of the land across the river, and Shethar-bozenai and his friends the Apharsachites, living across the river, sent to Darius the king:

title: Ezra 5:7
text: They sent him a letter saying, To Darius the king, all peace:

title: Ezra 5:8
text: This is to give the king word that we went into the land of Judah, to the house of the great God, which is made of great stones, and has its walls supported with wood, and the work is going on with industry, and they are doing it well.

title: Ezra 5:9
text: Then we said to the men responsible, who gave you authority for the building of this house and these walls?

title: Ezra 5:10
text: And we made request for their names, so that we might send you word, and give you the names of the men at the head of them.

title: Ezra 5:11
text: And they made answer to us, saying, We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and we are building the house which was put up in times long past and was designed and made complete by a great king of Israel.

title: Ezra 5:12
text: But when the God of heaven was moved to wrath by our fathers, he gave them up into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, the Chaldaean, who sent destruction on this house and took the people away into Babylon.

title: Ezra 5:13
text: But in the first year of Cyrus, king of Babylon, Cyrus the king gave an order for the building of this house of God;

title: Ezra 5:14
text: And the gold and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took from the Temple which was in Jerusalem, and put into the house of his god in Babylon, these Cyrus the king took from the house of his god in Babylon, and gave to one named Sheshbazzar, whom he had made ruler;

title: Ezra 5:15
text: And he said to him, Go, take these vessels, and put them in the Temple in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be put up again in its place.

title: Ezra 5:16
text: Then this same Sheshbazzar came and put the house of God in Jerusalem on its bases: and from that time till now the building has been going on, but it is still not complete.

title: Ezra 5:17
text: So now, if it seems good to the king, let search be made in the king's store-house at Babylon, to see if it is true that an order was given by Cyrus the king for the building of this house of God at Jerusalem, and let the king send us word of his pleasure in connection with this business.

title: Ezra 6:1
text: ¶Then Darius the king gave an order and a search was made in the house of the records, where the things of value were stored up in Babylon.

title: Ezra 6:2
text: And at Achmetha, in the great house of the king in the land of Media, they came across a roll, in which this statement was put on record:

title: Ezra 6:3
text: In the first year of Cyrus the king, Cyrus the king made an order: In connection with the house of God at Jerusalem, let the house be put up, the place where they make offerings, and let the earth for the bases be put in place; let it be sixty cubits high and sixty cubits wide;

title: Ezra 6:4
text: With three lines of great stones and one line of new wood supports; and let the necessary money be given out of the king's store-house;

title: Ezra 6:5
text: And let the gold and silver vessels from the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took from the Temple at Jerusalem to Babylon, be given back and taken again to the Temple at Jerusalem, every one in its place, and put them in the house of God.

title: Ezra 6:6
text: So now, Tattenai, ruler of the land across the river, and Shethar-bozenai and your people the Apharsachites across the river, keep far from that place:

title: Ezra 6:7
text: Let the work of this house of God go on; let the ruler of the Jews and their responsible men put up this house of God in its place.

title: Ezra 6:8
text: Further, I give orders as to what you are to do for the responsible men of the Jews in connection with the building of this house of God: that from the king's wealth, that is, from the taxes got together in the land over the river, the money needed is to be given to these men readily, so that their work may not be stopped.

title: Ezra 6:9
text: And whatever they have need of, young oxen and sheep and lambs, for burned offerings to the God of heaven, grain, salt, wine, and oil, whatever the priests in Jerusalem say is necessary, is to be given to them day by day regularly:

title: Ezra 6:10
text: So that they may make offerings of a sweet smell to the God of heaven, with prayers for the life of the king and of his sons.

title: Ezra 6:11
text: And I have given orders that if anyone makes any change in this word, one of the supports is to be pulled out of his house, and he is to be lifted up and fixed to it; and his house is to be made waste for this;

title: Ezra 6:12
text: And may the God who has made it a resting-place for his name send destruction on all kings and peoples whose hands are outstretched to make any change in this or to do damage to this house of God at Jerusalem. I, Darius, have given this order, let it be done with all care.

title: Ezra 6:13
text: ¶Then Tattenai, the ruler across the river, and Shethar-bozenai and their people, because of the order given by King Darius, did as he had said with all care.

title: Ezra 6:14
text: And the responsible men of the Jews went on with their building, and did well, helped by the teaching of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah, the son of Iddo. They went on building till it was complete, in keeping with the word of the God of Israel, and the orders given by Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes, king of Persia.

title: Ezra 6:15
text: And the building of this house was complete on the third day of the month Adar, in the sixth year of the rule of Darius the king.

title: Ezra 6:16
text: And the children of Israel, the priests and the Levites, and the rest of those who had come back, kept the feast of the opening of this house of God with joy.

title: Ezra 6:17
text: And they gave as offerings at the opening of this house of God a hundred oxen, two hundred sheep, four hundred lambs; and for a sin-offering for all Israel, twelve he-goats, being the number of the tribes of Israel.

title: Ezra 6:18
text: And they put the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their order, for the worship of God at Jerusalem; as it is recorded in the book of Moses.

title: Ezra 6:19
text: And the children of Israel who had come back kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

title: Ezra 6:20
text: For the priests and the Levites had made themselves clean together; they were all clean: and they put the Passover lamb to death for all those who had come back, and for their brothers the priests and for themselves.

title: Ezra 6:21
text: And the children of Israel, who had come back, and all those who were joined to them, after separating themselves from the evil ways of the people of the land to become the servants of the Lord, the God of Israel, took food together,

title: Ezra 6:22
text: And kept the feast of unleavened bread for seven days with joy: for the Lord had made them full of joy, by turning the heart of the king of Assyria to them to give them help in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.

title: Ezra 7:1
text: ¶Now after these things, when Artaxerxes was king of Persia, Ezra, the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

title: Ezra 7:2
text: The son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,

title: Ezra 7:3
text: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,

title: Ezra 7:4
text: The son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,

title: Ezra 7:5
text: The son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest:

title: Ezra 7:6
text: This Ezra went up from Babylon; and he was a scribe, expert in the law of Moses which the Lord, the God of Israel, had given: and the king, moved by the Lord his God, gave him whatever he made request for.

title: Ezra 7:7
text: And some of the children of Israel went up, with some of the priests and the Levites and the music-makers and the door-keepers and the Nethinim, to Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.

title: Ezra 7:8
text: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, in the seventh year of the king's rule.

title: Ezra 7:9
text: For, starting his journey from Babylon on the first day of the first month, he came to Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month, by the good help of his God.

title: Ezra 7:10
text: For Ezra had given his mind to learning the law of the Lord and doing it, and to teaching his rules and decisions in Israel.

title: Ezra 7:11
text: ¶Now this is a copy of the letter which King Artaxerxes gave to Ezra, the priest and the scribe, who put into writing the words of the orders of the Lord, and of his rules for Israel:

title: Ezra 7:12
text: Artaxerxes, king of kings, to Ezra the priest, scribe of the law of the God of heaven, all peace;

title: Ezra 7:13
text: And now it is my order that all those of the people of Israel, and their priests and Levites in my kingdom, who are ready and have a desire to go to Jerusalem, are to go with you.

title: Ezra 7:14
text: Because you are sent by the king and his seven wise men, to get knowledge about Judah and Jerusalem, as you are ordered by the law of your God which is in your hand;

title: Ezra 7:15
text: And to take with you the silver and gold freely offered by the king and his wise men to the God of Israel, whose Temple is in Jerusalem,

title: Ezra 7:16
text: As well as all the silver and gold which you get from the land of Babylon, together with the offering of the people and of the priests, freely given for the house of their God, which is in Jerusalem:

title: Ezra 7:17
text: So with this money get with care oxen, sheep, and lambs, with their meal offerings and their drink offerings, to be offered on the altar of the house of your God, which is in Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 7:18
text: And whatever seems right to you and to your brothers to do with the rest of the silver and gold, that do, as may be pleasing to your God.

title: Ezra 7:19
text: And the vessels which have been given to you for the uses of the house of your God, you are to give to the God of Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 7:20
text: And whatever more is needed for the house of your God, and which you may have to give, take it from the king's store-house.

title: Ezra 7:21
text: And I, even I, Artaxerxes the king, now give orders to all keepers of the king's money across the river, that whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, may have need of from you, is to be done with all care,

title: Ezra 7:22
text: Up to a hundred talents of silver, a hundred measures of grain, a hundred measures of wine, and a hundred measures of oil, and salt without measure.

title: Ezra 7:23
text: Whatever is ordered by the God of heaven, let it be done completely for the house of the God of heaven; so that there may not be wrath against the kingdom of the king and his sons.

title: Ezra 7:24
text: In addition, we make it clear to you, that it will be against the law to put any tax or payment in goods or forced payment on any of the priests or Levites, the music-makers, door-keepers, Nethinim, or any servants of this house of God.

title: Ezra 7:25
text: And you, Ezra, by the wisdom of your God which is in you, are to put rulers and judges to have authority over all the people across the river who have knowledge of the laws of your God; and you are to give teaching to him who has no knowledge of them.

title: Ezra 7:26
text: And if anyone does not keep the law of your God and the law of the king, take care that punishment is given to him, by death or by driving him from his country or by taking away his goods or by putting him in prison.

title: Ezra 7:27
text: ¶Praise be to the Lord, the God of our fathers, who has put such a thing into the heart of the king, to make fair the house of the Lord which is in Jerusalem;

title: Ezra 7:28
text: And has given mercy to me before the king and his government and before all the king's great captains. And I was made strong by the hand of the Lord my God which was on me, and I got together out of Israel chief men to go up with me.

title: Ezra 8:1
text: ¶Now these are the heads of families who were listed of those who went up with me from Babylon, when Artaxerxes was king.

title: Ezra 8:2
text: Of the sons of Phinehas, Gershom; of the sons of Ithamar, Daniel; of the sons of David, Hattush;

title: Ezra 8:3
text: Of the sons of Shecaniah; of the sons of Parosh, Zechariah; and with him were listed a hundred and fifty males.

title: Ezra 8:4
text: Of the sons of Pahath-moab, Eliehoenai, the son of Zerahiah; and with him two hundred males.

title: Ezra 8:5
text: Of the sons of Shecaniah, the son of Jahaziel; and with him three hundred males.

title: Ezra 8:6
text: And of the sons of Adin, Ebed, the son of Jonathan; and with him fifty males.

title: Ezra 8:7
text: And of the sons of Elam, Jeshaiah; the son of Athaliah; and with him seventy males.

title: Ezra 8:8
text: And of the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah, the son of Michael; and with him eighty males.

title: Ezra 8:9
text: Of the sons of Joab, Obadiah, the son of Jehiel; and with him two hundred and eighteen males.

title: Ezra 8:10
text: And of the sons of Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah; and with him a hundred and sixty males.

title: Ezra 8:11
text: And of the sons of Bebai, Zechariah, the son of Bebai; and with him twenty-eight males.

title: Ezra 8:12
text: And of the sons of Azgad, Johanan, the son of Hakkatan; and with him a hundred and ten males.

title: Ezra 8:13
text: And of the sons of Adonikam, the last, whose names were Eliphelet, Jeuel, and Shemaiah; and with them sixty males.

title: Ezra 8:14
text: And of the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zabbud; and with them seventy males.

title: Ezra 8:15
text: And I made them come together by the river flowing to Ahava; and we were there in tents for three days: and after viewing the people and the priests I saw that no sons of Levi were there.

title: Ezra 8:16
text: Then I sent for Eliezer and Ariel and Shemaiah and Elnathan Jarib and Elnathan and Nathan and Zechariah and Meshullam, all responsible men; and for Joiarib and Elnathan, who were wise men.

title: Ezra 8:17
text: And I sent them to Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and gave them orders what to say to Iddo and his brothers the Nethinim at the place Casiphia, so that they might come back to us with men to do the work of the house of our God.

title: Ezra 8:18
text: And by the help of our God they got for us Ish-sechel, one of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah with his sons and brothers, eighteen;

title: Ezra 8:19
text: And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brothers and their sons, twenty;

title: Ezra 8:20
text: And of the Nethinim, to whom David and the captains had given the work of helping the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinim, all of them specially named.

title: Ezra 8:21
text: ¶Then I gave orders for a time of going without food, there by the river Ahava, so that we might make ourselves low before our God in prayer, requesting from him a straight way for us and for our little ones and for all our substance.

title: Ezra 8:22
text: For I would not, for shame, make request to the king for a band of armed men and horsemen to give us help against those who might make attacks on us on the way: for we had said to the king, The hand of our God is on his servants for good, but his power and his wrath are against all those who are turned away from him.

title: Ezra 8:23
text: So we went without food, requesting our God for this: and his ear was open to our prayer.

title: Ezra 8:24
text: ¶So I put on one side twelve of the chiefs of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers with them,

title: Ezra 8:25
text: And gave to them by weight the silver and the gold and the vessels, all the offering for the house of our God which the king and his wise men and his captains and all Israel there present had given:

title: Ezra 8:26
text: Measuring into their hands six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels, a hundred talents' weight, and a hundred talents of gold,

title: Ezra 8:27
text: And twenty gold basins, of a thousand darics, and two vessels of the best bright brass, equal in value to gold.

title: Ezra 8:28
text: And I said to them, You are holy to the Lord and the vessels are holy: and the silver and the gold are an offering freely given to the Lord, the God of your fathers.

title: Ezra 8:29
text: Take care of them and keep them, till you put them on the scales before the chiefs of the priests and the Levites and the chiefs of the families of Israel, in Jerusalem, in the rooms of the house of the Lord.

title: Ezra 8:30
text: So the priests and the Levites took the weight of silver and gold and the vessels, to take them to Jerusalem into the house of our God.

title: Ezra 8:31
text: ¶Then we went away from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Jerusalem; and the hand of our God was on us, and he gave us salvation from our haters and those who were waiting to make an attack on us by the way.

title: Ezra 8:32
text: And we came to Jerusalem and were there for three days.

title: Ezra 8:33
text: And on the fourth day, the silver and the gold and the vessels were measured out by weight in the house of our God into the hands of Meremoth, the son of Uriah, the priest; and with him was Eleazar, the son of Phinehas; and with them were Jozabad, the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah, the son of Binnui, the Levites;

title: Ezra 8:34
text: All was handed over by number and by weight: and the weight was put on record at that time.

title: Ezra 8:35
text: And those who had been prisoners, who had come back from a strange land, made burned offerings to the God of Israel, twelve oxen for all Israel, ninety-six male sheep, seventy-seven lambs, twelve he-goats for a sin-offering: all this was a burned offering to the Lord.

title: Ezra 8:36
text: And they gave the king's orders to the king's captains and the rulers across the river, and they gave the people and the house of God the help which was needed.

title: Ezra 9:1
text: ¶Now after these things were done, the captains came to me and said, The people of Israel and the priests and Levites have not kept themselves separate from the people of the lands, but have taken part in the disgusting ways of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.

title: Ezra 9:2
text: For they have taken their daughters for themselves and for their sons, so that the holy seed has been mixed with the peoples of the lands; and in fact the captains and rulers have been the first to do this evil.

title: Ezra 9:3
text: And hearing this, with signs of grief and pulling out the hair of my head and my chin, I took my seat on the earth deeply troubled.

title: Ezra 9:4
text: Then everyone who went in fear of the words of the God of Israel, because of the sin of those who had come back, came together to me; and I kept where I was, overcome with grief, till the evening offering.

title: Ezra 9:5
text: ¶And at the evening offering, having made myself low before God, I got up, and with signs of grief, falling down on my knees, with my hands stretched out to the Lord my God,

title: Ezra 9:6
text: I said, O my God, shame keeps me from lifting up my face to you, my God: for our sins are increased higher than our heads and our evil-doing has come up to heaven.

title: Ezra 9:7
text: From the days of our fathers till this day we have been great sinners; and for our sins, we and our kings and our priests have been given up into the hands of the kings of the lands, to the sword and to prison and to loss of goods and to shame of face, as it is this day.

title: Ezra 9:8
text: And now for a little time grace has come to us from the Lord our God, to let a small band of us get free and to give us a nail in his holy place, so that our God may give light to our eyes and a measure of new life in our prison chains.

title: Ezra 9:9
text: For we are servants; but our God has not been turned away from us in our prison, but has had mercy on us before the eyes of the kings of Persia, to give us new strength to put up again the house of our God and to make fair its waste places, and to give us a wall in Judah and Jerusalem.

title: Ezra 9:10
text: And now, O our God, what are we to say after this? for we have not kept your laws,

title: Ezra 9:11
text: Which you gave to your servants the prophets, saying, The land into which you are going, to take it for a heritage, is an unclean land, because of the evil lives of the peoples of the land and their disgusting ways, which have made the land unclean from end to end.

title: Ezra 9:12
text: So now do not give your daughters to their sons or take their daughters for your sons or do anything for their peace or well-being for ever; so that you may be strong, living on the good of the land, and handing it on to your children for a heritage for ever.

title: Ezra 9:13
text: And after everything which has come on us because of our evil-doing and our great sin, and seeing that the punishment which you, O God, have given us, is less than the measure of our sins, and that you have kept from death those of us who are here;

title: Ezra 9:14
text: Are we again to go against your orders, taking wives from among the people who do these disgusting things? would you not be angry with us till our destruction was complete, till there was not one who got away safe?

title: Ezra 9:15
text: O Lord God of Israel, righteousness is yours; we are only a small band which has been kept from death, as at this day: see, we are before you in our sin; for no one may keep his place before you because of this.

title: Ezra 10:1
text: ¶Now while Ezra was making his prayer and his statement of wrongdoing, weeping and falling down before the house of God, a very great number of men and women and children out of Israel came together round him: for the people were weeping bitterly.

title: Ezra 10:2
text: And Shecaniah, the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answering, said to Ezra, We have done evil against our God, and have taken as our wives strange women of the peoples of the land: but still there is hope for Israel in this question.

title: Ezra 10:3
text: Let us now make an agreement with our God to put away all the wives and all their children, if it seems right to my lord and to those who go in fear of the words of our God; and let it be done in keeping with the law.

title: Ezra 10:4
text: Up, now! for this is your business, and we are with you; take heart and do it.

title: Ezra 10:5
text: Then Ezra got up, and made the chiefs of the priests and the Levites and all Israel take an oath that they would do this. So they took an oath.

title: Ezra 10:6
text: ¶Then Ezra got up from before the house of God and went into the room of Jehohanan, the son of Eliashib; but when he came there, he took no food or drink, for he was sorrowing for the sin of those who had come back.

title: Ezra 10:7
text: And they made a public statement through all Judah and Jerusalem, to all those who had come back, that they were to come together to Jerusalem;

title: Ezra 10:8
text: And that if anyone did not come before three days were past, as ordered by the rulers and the responsible men, all his goods would be put under the curse, and he himself would be cut off from the meeting of the people who had come back.

title: Ezra 10:9
text: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin came together to Jerusalem before three days were past; it was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people were seated in the wide square in front of the house of God, shaking with fear because of this business and because of the great rain.

title: Ezra 10:10
text: And Ezra the priest got to his feet and said to them, You have done wrong and taken strange women for your wives, so increasing the sin of Israel.

title: Ezra 10:11
text: So now, give praise to the Lord, the God of your fathers, and do his pleasure; and make yourselves separate from the peoples of the land and from the strange women.

title: Ezra 10:12
text: Then all the people, answering, said with a loud voice, As you have said, so it is right for us to do.

title: Ezra 10:13
text: But the number of people is great, and it is a time of much rain; it is not possible for us to go on waiting outside, and this is not a thing which may be done in one day or even two: for our sin in this business is great.

title: Ezra 10:14
text: So now let our rulers be representatives for all the people, and let all those in our towns who are married to strange women come at fixed times, and with them the responsible men and the judges of every town, till the burning wrath of our God is turned away from us, and this has been done.

title: Ezra 10:15
text: ¶Only Jonathan, the son of Asahel, and Jahzeiah, the son of Tikvah, were against this, Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite supporting them.

title: Ezra 10:16
text: So those who had come back did so. And Ezra the priest, with certain heads of families, by their fathers' families, all of them by their names, were marked out; and on the first day of the tenth month they took their places to go into the question with care.

title: Ezra 10:17
text: And they got to the end of all the men who were married to strange women by the first day of the first month.

title: Ezra 10:18
text: And among the sons of the priests who were married to strange women were these: of the sons of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak and his brothers, Maaseiah and Eliezer and Jarib and Gedaliah.

title: Ezra 10:19
text: And they gave their word that they would put away their wives; and for their sin, they gave an offering of a male sheep of the flock.

title: Ezra 10:20
text: And of the sons of Immer, Hanani and Zebadiah.

title: Ezra 10:21
text: And of the sons of Harim, Maaseiah and Elijah and Shemaiah and Jehiel and Uzziah.

title: Ezra 10:22
text: And of the sons of Pashhur, Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.

title: Ezra 10:23
text: And of the Levites, Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah (that is Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

title: Ezra 10:24
text: And of the music-makers, Eliashib; and of the door-keepers, Shallum and Telem and Uri.

title: Ezra 10:25
text: And of Israel, the sons of Parosh, Ramiah and Izziah and Malchijah and Mijamin and Eleazar and Malchijah and Benaiah.

title: Ezra 10:26
text: And of the sons of Elam, Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel and Abdi and Jeremoth and Elijah.

title: Ezra 10:27
text: And of the sons of Zattu, Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth and Zabad and Aziza.

title: Ezra 10:28
text: And of the sons of Bebai, Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, Athlai.

title: Ezra 10:29
text: And of the sons of Bani, Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub and Sheal, Jeremoth.

title: Ezra 10:30
text: And of the sons of Pahath-moab, Adna and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel and Binnui and Manasseh.

title: Ezra 10:31
text: And of the sons of Harim, Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,

title: Ezra 10:32
text: Benjamin, Malluch, Shemariah.

title: Ezra 10:33
text: Of the sons of Hashum, Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, Shimei.

title: Ezra 10:34
text: Of the sons of Bani, Maadai, Amram, and Uel,

title: Ezra 10:35
text: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi,

title: Ezra 10:36
text: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,

title: Ezra 10:37
text: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasu,

title: Ezra 10:38
text: And Bani and Binnui, Shimei;

title: Ezra 10:39
text: And Shelemiah and Nathan and Adaiah,

title: Ezra 10:40
text: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

title: Ezra 10:41
text: Azarel and Shelemiah, Shemariah,

title: Ezra 10:42
text: Shallum, Amariah, Joseph.

title: Ezra 10:43
text: Of the sons of Nebo, Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Iddo, and Joel, Benaiah.

title: Ezra 10:44
text: All these had taken strange wives; and some of them had wives by whom they had offspring.

title: Nehemiah 1:1
text: ¶The history of Nehemiah, the son of Hacaliah. Now it came about, in the month Chislev, in the twentieth year, when I was in Shushan, the king's town,

title: Nehemiah 1:2
text: That Hanani, one of my brothers, came with certain men from Judah; and in answer to my request for news of the Jews who had been prisoners and had got away, and of Jerusalem,

title: Nehemiah 1:3
text: They said to me, The small band of Jews now living there in the land are in great trouble and shame: the wall of Jerusalem has been broken down, and its doorways burned with fire.

title: Nehemiah 1:4
text: Then, after hearing these words, for some days I gave myself up to weeping and sorrow, seated on the earth; and taking no food I made prayer to the God of heaven,

title: Nehemiah 1:5
text: ¶And said, O Lord, the God of heaven, the great God, greatly to be feared, keeping faith and mercy with those who have love for him and are true to his laws:

title: Nehemiah 1:6
text: Let your ear now take note and let your eyes be open, so that you may give ear to the prayer of your servant, which I make before you at this time, day and night, for the children of Israel, your servants, while I put before you the sins of the children of Israel, which we have done against you: truly, I and my father's people are sinners.

title: Nehemiah 1:7
text: We have done great wrong against you, and have not kept the orders, the rules, and the decisions, which you gave to your servant Moses.

title: Nehemiah 1:8
text: Keep in mind, O Lord, the order you gave your servant Moses, saying, If you do wrong I will send you wandering among the peoples:

title: Nehemiah 1:9
text: But if you come back to me and keep my orders and do them, even if those of you who have been forced out are living in the farthest parts of heaven, I will get them from there, and take them back to the place marked out by me for the resting-place of my name.

title: Nehemiah 1:10
